array.string: echo "[$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] tick"; cd "/Users/jalila/Documents/Claude/Projects/VoxMap/voxmap-app" || { echo " ! cd failed"; exit 1; }; /usr/bin/git fetch origin main 2>&1 | sed 's/^/ fetch: /'; ahead=$(/usr/bin/git rev-list --count origin/main..HEAD 2>/dev/null); if [ "${ahead:-0}" -gt 0 ]; then echo " pushing $ahead commit(s)"; /usr/bin/git push origin main 2>&1 | sed 's/^/ push: /'; else echo " up to date"; fi
